game.title: Just Cause 2
game.blurb: Open-world action game in which Rico Rodriguez sets out to topple the regime on the Southeast Asian island of Panau, from Avalanche Studios and Square Enix, released 2010-03-23. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page in the "Guides at completion stage 2" category, but the same page is also in "Stubs" and its walkthrough is not written: the only subpages are Achievements and trophies (about 8,700 characters), Agency Missions (about 5,500), Roaches (about 1,700), Controls (about 1,100), SAM sites (about 1,000), Reapers (about 800) and a short Table of Contents (about 550). Walkthrough, Gameplay, Cheats and Ular Boys are linked but not written. So it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. justcause.fandom.com answers the API, with about 77 linked pages, including the seven story mission names, "Stronghold", "Chaos" and "Downloadable content for Just Cause 2"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "ValveTestApp8190" (a placeholder name); the store list confirms app 8190. None of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden, so there are no spoiler-guarded entries. RAWG lists a playtime of only 3 hours, which looks low. "Up to the Challenge 1" and "2" (complete challenges) were put in Exploration; "Halfway there" and "Perfectionist" (completion percentage) too.
